Write steps go through full control checks and read-back and wait for the completion condition within the timeout. A condition whose tag has no valid value counts as failed; parallel branches must join at the same join step (all/any); loops are only allowed through jump steps with a count limit. On failure: stop (default), continue (record failure and fall through), or go to (e.g. a safe shutdown step; the run is recorded as failed). Saving checks for unreachable steps, missing joins and unbounded loops. If a step's tag requires dual approval, the sequence itself must require dual approval.

累计器、设备运行小时、能耗积分与受限脚本。结果写入自动生成的派生测点（名称为“任: Accumulators, equipment running hours, energy integration and restricted scripts. Results are written to auto-generated derived tags (named "job.output") usable in trends, alarms, reports and screens. State is persisted every 10 s and continues after restart; a snapshot is kept before each periodic reset.
结束早于开始表示跨零点（如夜班 20:00-08:00）；按班次开始那天判断星期: An end earlier than the start spans midnight (e.g. night shift 20:00-08:00); the weekday is that of the shift start.
统计及最近 200 条事件、120 批采样保留在当前采集任务内存中；配置重建或服: Statistics, the last 200 events and 120 sample batches are kept in the current collection task's memory; counts restart after config rebuild or service restart. Snapshot time {0}.
网关重新连接并确认配置后才能接受新控制。: New control is accepted only after the gateway reconnects and confirms its config.
脉冲：按计数差累计，满量程回绕自动补足，计数回落视为复位从 0 起算；坏质量期间: Pulse: accumulates count differences, wraps at full scale automatically, a falling count is a reset from 0; during bad quality the baseline is held and the difference is added on recovery. Flow: trapezoidal integration; the factor converts the flow unit to "per second" (e.g. m³/h uses 1/3600≈0.000277778).
若主机在线将转交主机执行正常切换；主机不在线时需仲裁确认其租约已过期。请填写原因: If the primary is online it performs a normal switchover; otherwise arbitration must confirm its lease has expired. Enter a reason (audited).

计算在中心执行，结果可用于实时监视、历史、报警和画面绑定。计算测点只读；输入缺失: Calculations run at the center; results can be used in realtime, history, alarms and screen bindings. Calculated tags are read-only; when inputs are missing, stale or bad, the last value is kept and the quality is marked.

软元件+编号；X/Y/B/W/SB/SW/DX/DY 为十六进制编号，其余十进制: Device + number; X/Y/B/W/SB/SW/DX/DY are hexadecimal, others decimal; word bits (D100.3) are read-only
输入大于阈值视为运行。输出累计小时、启停次数、本周期值、距上次维护小时与“到期需: Input above the threshold counts as running. Outputs accumulated hours, start count, current-period value, hours since last maintenance and "maintenance due" (1/0), which can be alarmed.

连接失败后，先核对服务器证书的 SHA-256 指纹，再建立信任。客户端公钥证书: When the connection fails, verify the server certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint before trusting it. The client public key certificate must be trusted on the server; the private key is never downloaded.

配方下发经过现场操作的同一控制闭环：全部参数先整体预检查（控制权、挂牌、限幅、变: Recipe download uses the same control pipeline as field control: all parameters are pre-checked together (ownership, tag-out, limits, rate of change, permissives, recipe limits) and only if all pass are they written one by one and verified by read-back; dual approval of the whole batch when required. Any failed parameter stops immediately and the result is clearly marked "partially downloaded"; nothing is resent or rolled back automatically.

释放会使原会话失效，并允许新进程连接。离线的旧进程要恢复联系后才会获知撤权，中心: Releasing invalidates the old session and lets a new process connect. An offline old process learns of the revocation only after reconnecting; the center cannot confirm a field shutdown for you.
